page.notes: The first word of the text is a large initial "C" joined to "Caput". The line "minist..." beneath it is partly obscured by the initial; readings in the first lines are doubtful. Greek-free page; the bottom of the page is cut off, so the text ends mid-sentence. The first line is cut at the top; the word "refellitur" is partly obscured. The last word "nem" is a catchword-like fragment at the right, read as the end of "consolationem" continued; treated as part of the text. Some words in the italic lines are uncertain, for example "Sectemini" and "spiritus", which may read differently.
